set.name: Cherokee Nation
set.note: Approximate extent of Cherokee Nation lands before the Treaty of Hopewell (from Royce, Indian Land Cessions, 1899).

entries.reason: Cliopatria has no Cherokee polity. Cherokee lands as they stood after the cession to Georgia of 31 May 1783 and before the Treaty of Hopewell (28 Nov 1785): the union of every Royce 1899 area the Cherokee ceded to the United States from 1785 to 1835 (areas 3, 8, 42, 52, 57-59, 64, 76, 79, 83-86, 101-109, 203). Hopewell confirmed the 1783 Georgia line (Tugaloo river - Currahee mountain - head of the south fork of the Oconee), so the union is the 1783-1784 extent. Earlier colonial-era extents are separate entries. Approximate (digitised 1899 maps, simplified to about 2 km).
